result.topic_en: The scan is a two-page spread: the left page (p. 274) ends a numerical table from the preceding paper, and the right page (p. 275) opens E598, where Euler announces that he will explain Lagrange's 1773 results on divisors of the form $Btt+Ctu+Duu$ in more special cases and assess how far they support number-theoretic theorems he had found only by induction.
result.transcription:
[Left page, p. 274, end of the preceding paper; the page is printed rotated: a table of decimal values of powers $q^{15}$ through $q^{31}$ divided by products of integers, e.g. $\frac{q^{15}}{1\cdot\ldots\cdot 15} = 0,00000,00006,68803,51098,11467,225$ … down to $\frac{q^{31}}{1\cdot\ldots\cdot 31} = 0,00000,00000,00000,00000,00000,000$, followed by:]
Hae quidem potestates diuisae sunt per certos numeros, qui autem plerumque sunt ii ipsi, per quos eaedem potestates ipsius $\pi$ in superioribus formulis diuisi occurrunt, vnde euolutio in fractiones decimales eo facilior redditur.

[Right page, p. 275:]
) 275 (
DE
INSIGNI PROMOTIONE
SCIENTIAE NVMERORVM.
§. 1.
Eximia omnino sunt, quae celeberr. La Grange in Comment. Academiae Regiae Borussicae pro Anno 1773 de diuisoribus formulae generalissimae $Btt + Ctu + Duu$ demonstrauit, et maximam lucem in scientia numerorum, quae etiamnunc tantis tenebris est inuoluta, accendunt. Ob hoc ipsum autem, quod ista tractatio maxime est generalis, ii qui non satis sunt exercitati in huiusmodi speculationibus, non parum difficultatis offendunt, neque vim talium sublimium demonstrationum satis perspicere valent. Quamobrem haud inutile erit omnia momenta, quibus hae demonstrationes innituntur, diligentius explicare atque ad formulas magis speciales accommodare, quandoquidem hoc modo omnia facilius intelligi poterunt. Deinde imprimis accuratius exponam, quantum firmamentum hinc plurimis theorematibus, quorum veritatem per solam inductionem mihi quidem cognoscere licuit, afferri possit, vnde multo [?] clarius parebit, quantum adhuc ad eorum perfectam demonstrationem desideretur.
Mm 2

items.quote: Quamobrem haud inutile erit omnia momenta, quibus hae demonstrationes innituntur, diligentius explicare atque ad formulas magis speciales accommodare
items.english: Therefore it will not be useless to explain more carefully all the points on which these demonstrations rest and to adapt them to more special formulas.

items.quote: Deinde imprimis accuratius exponam, quantum firmamentum hinc plurimis theorematibus, quorum veritatem per solam inductionem mihi quidem cognoscere licuit, afferri possit
items.english: Then above all I shall set out more precisely how much support can be brought from this to very many theorems whose truth I have been able to recognise only by induction.

items.quote: plurimis theorematibus, quorum veritatem per solam inductionem mihi quidem cognoscere licuit
items.english: Very many theorems whose truth I have been able to recognise only by induction (i.e., not yet proved).
